title: oracle comment wrong: first disconnect test exercises select\! closed() not is_closed()
description: events_coalescing_task_exits_on_disconnect_before_any_broadcast oracle comment (lines 1658-1665) says 'The select\! closed() arm does NOT fire in this test' and that the task exits via is_closed() in the empty-batch path. This is false. After drop(resp) drops live_rx, live_tx.closed() becomes ready synchronously. The task is then woken and on the very next yield (line 1704) the select\! closed() arm fires — the task exits before the Chat broadcast at line 1711 is ever sent. The Chat broadcast goes to an already-empty receiver set. The is_closed() path is not exercised at all. A reader of the comment will have a false model of what code path is tested.
